nodes.svg_description: Centered white rounded-rectangle card (corner radius ~40px) with no stroke.

nodes.asset_description: Set of playful hand-drawn science doodles arranged around the inner edges of the white card: top-center tilted translucent blue beaker with measurement ticks and bubbles; top-right yellow test tube with beige stopper and pale foam; left side vertical battery split pink upper half with plus sign and orange lower half with minus sign; lower-left beige dropper with pink bulb dispensing a blue droplet; bottom spanning left area safety goggles in light gray with dark blue outline and white reflections; bottom-right cluster of molecule spheres (yellow and light green) connected by red rods with small highlights. All illustrations have dark blue outlines and soft flat fills.
